title: Towards Out-of-Distribution Uncertainty Quantification for Machine-Learned Interatomic Potentials via Pre-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.41801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Informative uncertainty quantification (UQ) is essential for the practical deployment of machine-learned interatomic potentials (MLIPs), as it provides insight into their reliability across chemical space. Although numerous post-hoc uncertainty estimation methods for MLIPs have recently been proposed, most have been trained in low-data regimes, restricting their applicability to narrow domains of interest. Inspired by the emergence of foundational MLIPs, we propose pre-training uncertainty estimators on large, diverse datasets to enable broader applicability. We pre-train several UQ models on large materials science datasets to quantify the uncertainty of different MLIPs, and evaluate their performance on both in-distribution and out-of-domain (OOD) adsorption-energy predictions. translated_title: 通过预训练实现机器学习原子间势的分布外不确定性量化
translated_abstract: 信息丰富的不确定性量化（UQ）对于机器学习原子间势（MLIPs）的实际部署至关重要，因为它能够揭示这些模型在整个化学空间中的可靠性。尽管近期已提出了许多针对MLIPs的事后不确定性估计方法，但其中大多数都是在低数据量条件下训练的，这限制了它们仅适用于狭窄的领域。受基础MLIPs兴起的启发，我们提出在大型、多样化的数据集上预训练不确定性估计器，以实现更广泛的适用性。我们在大型材料科学数据集上预训练了多个UQ模型，用于量化不同MLIPs的不确定性，并在分布内和分布外（OOD）吸附能预测任务上评估了它们的性能。我们发现，预训练的不确定性估计器能够在多个数据集上提供可行的零样本（zero-shot）不确定性估计，而微调则能够持续带来性能提升。
tldr: 本文提出在大型多样化材料科学数据集上预训练不确定性估计器，使机器学习原子间势能够实现零样本的分布外不确定性量化，且通过微调可进一步提升性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pre-training uncertainty estimators on large, diverse materials science datasets to enable zero-shot out-of-distribution uncertainty quantification for machine-learned interatomic potentials, with fine-tuning further improving performance.
